learning_outcomes.text: To have comprehensive information about a matter, to write and to present
To able to determine, describe and solve of problems in manufacturing, for this purpose; to chose an appropriate method, program and model and practice.
To able to make plan and design about manufacturing, to able to determine manufacturing method and related to these, to able to chose machine, equipment, tool and material.
To able to take responsibility about manufacturing and technical subjects, to able to prepare project independently or to contribute to the project prepared by other groups.
Understand and apply different application techniques as regard to the subject concerned.
